Load packages and setup emude
```{r}
library(JuliaCall)
library(tidyverse)
library(emude)
emude_setup()
```

Create dummy dataset for testing
```{r}
diff_data <- data.frame(time = seq(1,50,1),
                        values = rpois(n = 50, lambda = 100),
                        species = rep(1,50) #needs to be handled if string
                        )

step <- function(u,nn,p,t){
  stepu = u[1]*exp(nn[1]*(1-u[1]/p$K))
  return(c(stepu))
}

testdiff <- custom_difference(data = diff_data, step = step, 
                  initial_parameters = list(K = 130),
                  time_column_name = "time")
predict_UDE(testdiff, test_data = diff_data)

train_UDE(testdiff, loss_function = "marginal likelihood")
```
